description: This file contains helper functions for parsing and comparing version strings, specifically for device descriptors. It includes functions to convert version strings to integer arrays, compare version arrays, and compare version strings.

methods.name: versionStringToInt
methods.description: Converts a version string into an array of integers, handling special cases like hex version numbers.

methods.name: compareVersionArrays
methods.description: Compares two version arrays to determine their relative order.

methods.name: compareVersionStrings
methods.description: Compares two version strings by converting them to integer arrays and then comparing.
